items.acceptance: A healthy daemon renews before expiry through an observed current lease predecessor.
items.evidence: In main (PR #2508, #2532): eliotd per-tick DaemonProgressObservation producer (bins/eliotd/src/supervision_progress.rs) + Kernel typed renewal join (bins/eliot-kernel/src/lib.rs renew_current_supervision_with_progress). Runtime proof pending by owner order.

items.acceptance: Renewal revision and live receipt advance exactly once and remain idempotent on exact replay.
items.evidence: In main: classify_eliotd_live_receipt_transition ExactReplay + decision-function tests (tests.rs). Runtime proof pending by owner order.

items.acceptance: Store unavailable with daemon transport/progress alive yields separate Store degradation, not automatic daemon lease loss unless policy requires it.
items.evidence: In main: StoreHealth is evidence-only, never advances progress cursors (daemon_supervision.rs). Runtime proof pending by owner order.

items.acceptance: Daemon process alive but no authenticated progress/heartbeat cannot retain independent supervision indefinitely.
items.evidence: In main: stale horizon 3xrenew_after_ms / 3 missed renewals expire the lease (stale_renewal_expired). Runtime proof pending by owner order.

items.acceptance: Stale generation/session/epoch, clock rollback, suspend/resume and predecessor mismatch fail renewal.
items.evidence: In main: typed renewal join fail-closed paths + decision-function tests. Runtime proof pending by owner order.

items.acceptance: Lease expiry revokes dependent effect admission and remains visible in readiness/Governance Profile.
items.evidence: This slice: expiry branch calls revoke_supervision_expired_effect_admission (same file) which runs the production revocation promote_agent_bridge_profile(None) (bins/eliot-kernel/src/agent_bridge.rs, also used by mark_daemon_degraded/record_daemon_failed) and emits kernel.daemon.supervision_expired_effects_revoked. Readiness visibility (in main, PR #2532): renew_daemon_supervision_for_probe fails closed on supervision_expired; refusal answers carry the expiry code plus the exact durable head. Residual: no separate GovernanceProfile enum value for supervision-expiry; the visible surface is ProbeReady failure + revoked bridge admission + retained expired marker.

items.acceptance: Restart/recovery cannot renew a predecessor from an old process generation.
items.evidence: In main: fresh binding resets supervision_progress/unbound continuity + clears the expired marker (daemon_request_dispatch.rs rebind path). Runtime proof pending by owner order.

items.acceptance: Live receipt publication, Watchdog readback and #11 daemon-loss Product Pulse use the same renewal evidence.
items.evidence: In main: renewal publishes live receipt through the replacement rule; Watchdog readback + #11 pulse are test-phase consumers.
